thread:
alex: Quick perf notes: ran a 1-8 batch sweep across Llama-2-13b, Mixtral-8x7B, and Qwen-7B on gpu-pool-8g. Found non-linear latency growth above batch=4 for Qwen when the kernel selector chooses matmul_f16_optimized. KV cache eviction spikes at ~2k ctx for Mixtral with batching >2. Dumping quick notes.
maria: Logs? p95 numbers?
perf-bot: perf/suite/2026-12-03 - Llama-2-13b batch1 p95=48ms batch4=76ms batch8=160ms; Mixtral-8x7B batch1=35ms batch4=68ms batch8=140ms; Qwen-7B batch1=42ms batch4=95ms batch8=360ms. Attached flamegraphs and kernel traces.
cheng: Qwen's 360ms smells like kernel fallback + memcpy thrash. Is selector toggling between two kernels at runtime?
sam: Saw the same on dedicated pool with CUDA12.5. Selector picked tch_int8 for parts which falls back to generic GEMM on long sequences causing memcpy penalties (device->host->device in traces).
alex: Key takeaways: 1) kernel routing needs a seq-aware heuristic — prefer fp16_matmul for short seqs, tiled_gemm for high batch*seq combos. 2) cap per-GPU batch for Qwen at 4 on 8g to keep tail latency sane. 3) KV-evict traces show KVMem pressure at ~2k tokens for Mixtral only when batching>2.
maria: RoPE scaling — did you try fractional-rope tweaks? Any quality tradeoffs?
alex: Yes. Enabling RoPE fractional_scale=0.95 for Mixtral reduced head-level overflow artifacts and decreased kv-evict events by ~30% on our chat eval set. No measurable quality regression on our prompts (BLEU-ish/ROUGE cursory checks). Qwen remains latency-sensitive.
cheng: Suggest micro-batching: split incoming batch N into min(N, batch_limit) micro-batches and stream merge tokens. That lowers peak KV pressure without changing client semantics.
sam: Also, kernel selector needs a cheap heuristic: if batch * avg_seq > 8192 => force tiled_gemm. Cheap integer math, avoids runtime probing. Add a unit test for selector behavior across seq distributions.
perf-bot: Created ticket PERF-2026: kernel-routing-heuristic. CI baseline tests attached.
maria: :thumbsup: Proposed config recs for next deploy: Llama-2-13b batch_limit=8, Mixtral-8x7B batch_limit=2 on 8g (or 4 on 16g), Qwen-7B batch_limit=4; RoPE fractional_scale default=0.95 for Mixtral; selector rule: "batch*avg_seq>8192 => tiled_gemm".
alex: I'll open a PR with selector + evict logging changes. @cheng can you prototype micro-batching router?
cheng: On it — PoC today, will link perf traces.
sam: Also recommend a regression alert: Qwen p95 > 200ms at batch=4 triggers investigation.
maria: Add a short blurb to release notes and console docs: "temporary Qwen batch cap and Mixtral RoPE scaling tweak to mitigate KV pressure".
alex: Action items recap: alex PR for selector/logging, cheng PoC micro-batcher, sam set up alert, maria updates docs. I'll post follow-up next week with new numbers. Thanks all!
